root_cause: app.js was stopping at removed legacy element #importScheduleBtn.
After that was guarded, it would also stop at removed legacy element #addProgressBtn.
Because app.js stopped before the final bindBulk() section, Delete Selected, Clear Selection, and many later core button handlers were never attached.
v13.js had another unguarded #addProgressBtn access, preventing later Inventory/Actual-related handlers in that compatibility layer from attaching.
fixes: Guards removed legacy controls instead of letting the core script abort.
Restores normal execution through all core button bindings.
Billing Delete explicitly clears child payment rows before deleting a billing, then refreshes the table.
Keeps the current GenCon/Subcon Issued Amount workflow and live finance logic.
